name: Sparse Voxel Octree Ray Traversal
definition: A ray traversal algorithm for a 3D sparse voxel octree implemented in a GLSL fragment shader. It uses parallel arrays to simulate a stack, handling valid internal nodes, leaf nodes, and empty space by casting rays to the next occupied voxel.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Ray Traversal renders sparse voxel data by traversing an octree to skip empty space, enabling efficient single-draw-call rendering without mesh generation.
